Distance from J = (xj, H - 15) to line BD: | (c - x0)*(H - 15) - H*xj | / sqrt((c - x0)^2 + H^2) = 15. Square: ((c - x0)*(H - 15) - H*xj)^2 = 225 * ((c - x0)^2 + H^2). (Equation4)

\[
J=\Bigl(\frac{s_{2}x_{0}+s_{1}(b-x_{0})}
                {s_{1}+s_{2}+\ell},\;h-15\Bigr)
    =\bigl(J_{x},h-15\bigr).
\]

A direct computation shows that the condition \(IJ=25\) reduces to

\[
h^{2}-46h-96=0,
\]

hence \(h=48\) (the negative root is extraneous).

--------------------------------------------------------------------
### 4.  Determining the bases  

From (3) with \(h=48\),

\[
\frac{b\cdot 48}{\,b+s_{1}+s_{2}\,}=8
\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
s_{1}+s_{2}=5b.                              \tag{5}
\]

From (4) with \(h=48\),

\[
15(s_{1}+s_{2})=33\,\ell.                     \tag{6}
\]

Using \(\ell=b-2x_{0}\) and (5)–(6) we obtain

\[
5b=\frac{11}{5}\,(b-2x_{0})\Longrightarrow
x_{0}=-\frac{7}{11}b,
\qquad
\ell=b-2x_{0}= \frac{25}{11}b.                \tag{7}
\]

Insert \(x_{0}\) from (7) into the definitions (2) of \(s_{1},s_{2}\) and
use (5):

\[
\sqrt{\Bigl(\frac{7}{11}b\Bigr)^{2}+48^{2}}
\;+\;
\sqrt{\Bigl(\frac{18}{11}b\Bigr)^{2}+48^{2}}=5b .
\]

Solving gives \(b=22\).  
Consequently

\[
AD=\ell=\frac{25}{11}\,b=50,\qquad
BC=b=22.
\]

--------------------------------------------------------------------
### 5.  Area of the trapezoid  

\[
\text{Area}= \frac{AD+BC}{2}\,h
            =\frac{50+22}{2}\times48
            =36\times48=1728.
\]

Since the area is an integer, the greatest integer not exceeding it is the
same number.
